name: Robust-transfer PPO (LN + Huber + smoothness)
tagline: LayerNorm-MLP actor/critic with orthogonal init, plus PPO with Huber value loss, per-minibatch advantage renorm, action-magnitude penalty, and tighter adaptive-KL.

key_hyperparams.name: heading_command
key_hyperparams.role: uses raw ang_vel_yaw target (matches MuJoCo eval)

diff_from_baseline: Vs default PPO: adds LayerNorm to every actor/critic hidden, replaces squared value loss with clipped Huber (δ=10), re-normalizes advantages per minibatch, adds an L2 penalty on action means, tightens the adaptive-KL trigger to 1.5×, and turns heading_command off in the env config.

name: Residual MLP + smooth-L1 + action-rate
tagline: ResNet-style actor/critic with LayerNorm, observation Gaussian noise during training, smooth-L1 value loss, and L2+rate action smoothness penalties.
diff_from_baseline: Vs default: replaces the plain MLP with a 2-block residual MLP + LN, adds Gaussian observation noise during training, switches the value loss to smooth-L1, augments the rollout with prev_actions and adds a (μ - μ_prev) rate penalty plus a μ² energy penalty, and bumps the lr/epochs/entropy default schedule.

name: Tanh-bounded PPO + reward squashing + sym-clip
tagline: tanh-squashed actions with std clamp + rsample, three-way symmetric/asymmetric clip surrogate, KL+behavior-clone aux losses, tanh-squashed rewards in storage.

key_hyperparams.name: λ_mix coef
key_hyperparams.role: GAE λ slightly modulated by terminal

diff_from_baseline: A heavily redesigned PPO: tanh-squashed actions with rsample and clamp, SiLU+LN MLP, a third symmetric-clip surrogate term, KL penalty + behavior-cloning auxiliary loss, KL-down-weighted entropy, tanh-squashed rewards in the rollout buffer, slightly truncation-modulated GAE λ, and Huber clipped value loss.

name: Wide LN-MLP + Huber + per-dim adv norm
tagline: Wider asymmetric actor [512,256,128] / critic [768,256,128] with LN, Huber value loss, optional per-dim advantage normalization.
diff_from_baseline: Vs default: widens the actor to [512,256,128] and critic to [768,256,128] with LayerNorm everywhere; replaces the squared value loss with clipped Huber and switches to per-dim advantage standardization; keeps the original 2.0× adaptive-KL lr schedule.

name: LN-MLP + Huber + entropy decay + priority replay
tagline: Wider LN actor/critic with episode-decayed action noise, Huber value loss, decaying entropy coef, and TD-error-priority minibatch sampling.
diff_from_baseline: Vs default: widens the actor/critic with LayerNorm, adds episode-decayed action noise, replaces squared value loss with clipped Huber, decays entropy_coef multiplicatively (floor 1e-3), and modifies the rollout buffer to store TD-errors and sample minibatches with prioritized probability — a PER-style PPO variant.
